results.name: An actual World blast destroys the owned depot and gates the real ruin, embers, light and existing secondary effects
results.method: Explicit isolated World.detonate at the unchanged target position plus two seconds of original World.step. No target HP/alive/burn/score assignments and no fabricated hit; this supplement does not claim a player-released ballistic bomb.

results.name: The depot remains visibly ruined after original fires and secondary effects expire instead of reverting to an intact shed
results.method: Ninety-five further seconds of original World.step with the original safe practice aircraft unchanged. Same oblique camera and final WebGL framebuffer ROI as the intact capture; changed-pixel evidence supplements the actual ruin draw.

results.method: Real WEBGL_lose_context loss and restore plus the native Resume mission control. Repeated ensureMeshes calls reuse restored VAOs. This is context-recovery proof, not a physical iPhone, frame-rate or complete audio-source leak audit.
